newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE to go cautiously up to 4,675.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE to go cautiously up to 4,675.

text.p: After an unsettled start, the FTSE 100 index may try to go cautiously higher on Tuesday, perhaps touching 4,675, technical analysts said.

The market had been hinting it would recover lost ground since the middle of last week but lacked the courage to make a strong leap, preferring to merely test its 10 day moving average -- which is currently at 4,663.
Its intra-day range had fallen to 20 points on Friday from 54 points last Tuesday, but volatility may increase as the week progresses, analysts said.
By 0738 GMT, the FTSE was up 7.0 at 4,668.8.

"With many European bourses as well as Wall Street now at record highs there is every reason to suppose the FTSE will also head higher," said one analyst, adding that lack of support from the gilts market would limit the FTSE's upward progress.
"Financial and pharmaceutical stocks which have been leading the market higher for several weeks should once again provide upward pull," said the analyst.
But he noted that short-term momentum readings for the FTSE are only near neutral levels which implies that any upward motion by the index will be weak at this stage.
